lead.headline: Allgeier lost the flex call by 9.1 — and AVIATO won anyway, 122.6 to 82.94
lead.deck: Both lineups are finished; ESPN has it at 100%. Week 7 opens with three AVIATO starters on bye.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Tyler Allgeier, started on the projection with Jeremiyah Love out, finished 5.8 on 18 carries while Alvin Kamara scored 14.9 on your bench; Bam Knight, who out-ran him, was cramping rather than hurt, so Arizona's backfield is a split while Love is out. Josh Allen finished 7.2 under his projection. None of it cost the week: Tuten (24.7), Likely (23.9) and Coker (15.7 on 13 targets) carried AVIATO to 122.6, and Bok-aneers finished at 82.94 — a second win. Week 7 is the question now: Allen, Tuten and McLaurin are on bye, Love starts at quarterback, and the back who fills Tuten's slot is Tuesday's projection. Watch the Giants: Winston was benched for J.J. McCarthy and Harbaugh will not name the Week 7 quarterback for Likely yet.

doFirst.empty: Nothing left to decide in Week 6: the result is in.
